brief: A small closed box with a lid to keep a pack of kitchen matches dry.

requirements.evidence: Single full-base cell (piece:0,0,0;full) with full bin; modest 1-cell footprint.
Full bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) + top cover + 6 side end caps; check_build meshClash clear.
Top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top fitted as removable lid.

Closed lidded shape shelters contents from splashes/dust, but parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material and configurator checks fit only; not verified waterproof, food-safe or heat-safe. No match-pack prop exists to stage inside, and a closed lid would hide it.
requirements.requirement: Keep a pack of kitchen matches dry

finish.summary: Small 1-cell closed box: full bin in a full base with top cover lid and capped sides, joints locked. Closed shape helps keep matches dry but is not verified waterproof.

events.text: A dry little box for your matches — I'll build a closed, lidded one.
